I went to this place just to remove a stitch from surgery. The stitch was already coming off, and I could see it would come out easily.

However, the lady, who I assume is the doctor or nurse, said she charges 100 baht per stitch. I asked her how much it would cost, and she said she couldn’t tell if it was a single stitch or continuous sewing. So, I asked her to check. I mentioned that if it was too expensive, I wouldn’t do it.

I went to her examination room and got on the bed for her to check. While checking, she just cut and removed the stitch without telling me the price. I asked her, "Oh, you haven’t told me the price yet. You just cut it without informing me of the cost!" She told me it would be 500 baht for just removing the stitch that was already almost off my face!

In the end, I negotiated down to 200 baht, but still, it was just for removing the stitch, and it literally took 2 minutes of work!

text: I agree with every negative review. The doctor is more like a hysterical woman on PMS. He came and went, took off his gown, put it back on, and said goodbye when I asked to see the price list to find out where the 2,000 baht price for the examination came from. Don't waste your time and money here. There are decent doctors on the island.

I was sick. All I needed was one antibiotic and a medical certificate. It shouldn't have cost more than 300 baht. The doctor took a heart rate monitor and had me touch it to my chest under two layers of thick clothing. He only touched it once. I didn't think he'd give me so much medicine. I thought he was asking about my symptoms so he'd write it on the medical certificate. And it was 900 baht in total. I was shocked. This will be the last time I come to this clinic. I'm so angry! In the end, he gave me a discount in exchange for pressing the star button. I want you to remember this as a lesson. Everyone at the clinic, this is truly bad karma. This is clearly a form of extortion.

Cons:

-Then he tried to haggle over the bill.

-In the end, we paid over 13,500 Baht for nothing! Except the realization that it was influenza. He could have renovated the toilets with that bill alone.
